description: Two members of the result supersede the same item, and a survivor requires it. report requires store-v1, which Step 1 adds; store-v2 and store-cloud both supersede store-v1, so Step 2 hides it and the hard-dependency guard reports AGSC-E802 naming report and store-v1.
